title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十二章、宫女蓝香

    包拯和公孙策来冷宫找蓝香，他们在冷宫见到了一个像幽灵一样的老宫女。
    “她就是蓝香吗？”包拯不敢相信，但又忍不住这样想。
    公孙策想的却不一样：“包拯，她说了孩子！冷宫里怎么有孩子？你知道这件事吗？”
    包拯摇了摇头。他想了想，走到门边，轻轻地问：“你是蓝香吗？我们不是坏人，我们是来帮你的。”
    “你……知道我的名字？”女人站在门后，惊慌地问：“你们……真的不是坏人？”
    “不是。蓝香，我们可以进去吗？”包拯温和地问。
    女人有点儿犹豫，但还是把门打开了。他们走进去，女人急忙跑到床边抱起一样东西，一边轻拍一边小声说着：“不哭不哭，好孩子不哭，他们不是坏人……”
    包拯看清她抱的东西，又被震惊了。她抱的只是一床小被子，根本不是孩子。包拯忍不住盯着女人看，她其实不老，应该没有四十岁，但头发全白了，再加上肤色暗沉，整个人又黑又瘦，便显得十分老。她轻轻拍着被子，说话的样子温柔极了。如果小被子真的是一个孩子，那她一定是个温柔的好母亲。包拯想起了太医院里那年轻医官的话：“精神有问题，疯疯傻傻很多年了。”包拯明白了，这就是太医院的医官们不愿意说起蓝香的原因吧！
    蓝香身上的衣服又破又旧，肩上还有几个小洞，但还是能看出来，那是宫女的衣服。她的确是一名宫女，只是年纪大了，精神还有点儿问题。皇宫里居然还有这样的宫女，说出去应该没有人会相信。如果今天早上说给包拯听，包拯也不会相信。但现在，真正来到冷宫，亲眼看到这么破败的环境和这样真实的蓝香，包拯相信了。这里确实是一个被皇宫忘记了的地方，住在这儿的蓝香应该也是个被人忘记了的宫女。
    这样的蓝香，要怎样问她二十一年前冷宫火灾后，她为什么从太医院拿了那么多治疗外伤的药呢？包拯有点儿问不出口。蓝香没有理他们，一直在和“孩子”说话。她个子很瘦弱，声音很小，看上去身体不太好。
    “蓝香，你的身体好像不太好，以前受过很重的伤吗？”包拯问。
    蓝香抱紧孩子，紧张地问：“受伤……谁受伤了？”
    “你，二十一年前你受过很重的伤吗？”
    “二十一年前……”蓝香的眼睛里空空的，她望着包拯，好像在回忆。
fullText.traditional:
第二十二章、宮女藍香

    包拯和公孫策來冷宮找藍香，他們在冷宮見到了一個像幽靈一樣的老宮女。
    “她就是藍香嗎？”包拯不敢相信，但又忍不住這樣想。
    公孫策想的卻不一樣：“包拯，她說了孩子！冷宮裡怎麼有孩子？你知道這件事嗎？”
    包拯搖了搖頭。他想了想，走到門邊，輕輕地問：“你是藍香嗎？我們不是壞人，我們是來幫你的。”
    “你……知道我的名字？”女人站在門後，驚慌地問：“你們……真的不是壞人？”
    “不是。藍香，我們可以進去嗎？”包拯溫和地問。
    女人有點兒猶豫，但還是把門打開了。他們走進去，女人急忙跑到床邊抱起一樣東西，一邊輕拍一邊小聲說著：“不哭不哭，好孩子不哭，他們不是壞人……”
    包拯看清她抱的東西，又被震驚了。她抱的只是一床小被子，根本不是孩子。包拯忍不住盯著女人看，她其實不老，應該沒有四十歲，但頭髮全白了，再加上膚色暗沉，整個人又黑又瘦，便顯得十分老。她輕輕拍著被子，說話的樣子溫柔極了。如果小被子真的是一個孩子，那她一定是個溫柔的好母親。包拯想起了太醫院裡那年輕醫官的話：“精神有問題，瘋瘋傻傻很多年了。”包拯明白了，這就是太醫院的醫官們不願意說起藍香的原因吧！
    藍香身上的衣服又破又舊，肩上還有幾個小洞，但還是能看出來，那是宮女的衣服。她的確是一名宮女，只是年紀大了，精神還有點兒問題。皇宮裡居然還有這樣的宮女，說出去應該沒有人會相信。如果今天早上說給包拯聽，包拯也不會相信。但現在，真正來到冷宮，親眼看到這麼破敗的環境和這樣真實的藍香，包拯相信了。這裡確實是一個被皇宮忘記了的地方，住在這兒的藍香應該也是個被人忘記了的宮女。
    這樣的藍香，要怎樣問她二十一年前冷宮火災後，她為什麼從太醫院拿了那麼多治療外傷的藥呢？包拯有點兒問不出口。藍香沒有理他們，一直在和“孩子”說話。她個子很瘦弱，聲音很小，看上去身體不太好。
    “藍香，你的身體好像不太好，以前受過很重的傷嗎？”包拯問。
    藍香抱緊孩子，緊張地問：“受傷……誰受傷了？”
    “你，二十一年前你受過很重的傷嗎？”
    “二十一年前……”藍香的眼睛裡空空的，她望著包拯，好像在回憶。

sentences.pinyin: tā gè zi hěn shòu ruò shēng yīn hěn xiǎo kàn shàng qù shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: She was very thin and frail, her voice soft, and she seemed to be in poor health.

sentences.simplified: “蓝香，你的身体好像不太好，以前受过很重的伤吗？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “藍香，你的身體好像不太好，以前受過很重的傷嗎？”包拯問。
sentences.pinyin: lán xiāng nǐ de shēn tǐ hǎo xiàng bú tài hǎo yǐ qián shòu guò hěn zhòng de shāng ma bāo zhěng wèn
sentences.english: “Lan Xiang, it seems like you are not in good health. Did you suffer a serious injury previously?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: 蓝香抱紧孩子，紧张地问：“受伤……谁受伤了？”
sentences.traditional: 藍香抱緊孩子，緊張地問：“受傷……誰受傷了？”
sentences.pinyin: lán xiāng bào jǐn hái zi jǐn zhāng de wèn shòu shāng shéi shòu shāng le
sentences.english: Lan Xiang hugged her child tightly and asked nervously, “Injured … who got injured?”

sentences.simplified: “你，二十一年前你受过很重的伤吗？”
sentences.traditional: “你，二十一年前你受過很重的傷嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ èr shí yī nián qián nǐ shòu guò hěn zhòng de shāng ma
sentences.english: “You. Did you suffer a serious injury twenty-one years ago?”

sentences.simplified: “二十一年前……”蓝香的眼睛里空空的，她望着包拯，好像在回忆。
sentences.traditional: “二十一年前……”藍香的眼睛裡空空的，她望著包拯，好像在回憶。
sentences.pinyin: èr shí yī nián qián lán xiāng de yǎn jing lǐ kōng kōng de tā wàng zhe bāo zhěng hǎo xiàng zài huí yì
sentences.english: “Twenty-one years ago …” Lan Xiang’s eyes were vacant. She looked at Bao Zheng, as if trying to recall.

sentence_translations: Chapter 22: The Palace Maid Lan Xiang
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce came to the Cold Palace to look for Lan Xiang.
In the Cold Palace, they saw an old palace maid who looked like a ghost.
“Is she Lan Xiang?” Bao Zheng couldn’t believe it, but he couldn’t help thinking this way.
Gongsun Ce thought differently: “Bao Zheng, she mentioned a child!
How could there be a child in the Cold Palace? Do you know anything about this?”
Bao Zheng shook his head.
He thought for a moment, walked to the door, and gently asked, “Are you Lan Xiang? We are not bad people, we are here to help you.”
“You … know my name?”
The woman stood behind the door, asking anxiously, “You … really aren’t bad people?”
“No. Lan Xiang, can we come in?” Bao Zheng asked gently.
The woman hesitated a bit, but still opened the door.
They walked in, and the woman hurried to the bedside to pick up something.
While gently patting it, she whispered, “Don’t cry, don’t cry, good child don’t cry, they are not bad people …”
Bao Zheng saw clearly what she was holding and was shocked again.
What she was holding was just a small quilt, not a child at all.
Bao Zheng couldn’t help but stare at the woman. She wasn’t actually old, probably not even forty, but her hair was completely white.
Coupled with her dull complexion, she appeared very dark and thin, which made her look very old.
She gently patted the quilt, speaking very tenderly.
If the small quilt were truly a child, she would certainly be a gentle and good mother.
Bao Zheng recalled the words of the young medical officer at the Imperial Academy of Medicine:
“She has mental issues, and has been acting crazy and foolish for many years.”
Bao Zheng understood.
This must be the reason why the medical officers at the Imperial Academy of Medicine were reluctant to talk about Lan Xiang!
Lan Xiang’s clothes were tattered and old, with several small holes on her shoulders.
But they were still recognizable as the clothes of a palace maid.
She was indeed a palace maid, it was just that she was old and had some mental issues.
If you said that there was such a maid in the imperial palace, no one would believe it.
Even if you had told Bao Zheng that morning, Bao Zheng wouldn’t have believed it.
But now, having actually arrived at the Cold Palace ..
.. and seen such a dilapidated environment and the real Lan Xiang with his own eyes, Bao Zheng believed it.
This was indeed a place forgotten by the imperial palace, ..
.. and Lan Xiang, who lived here, must also have been a palace maid who had been forgotten by people.
With Lan Xiang like this, how should he ask her, after the fire at the Cold Palace twenty-one years ago, ..
.. why she took so much medicine for treating external injuries from the Imperial Academy of Medicine?
Bao Zheng was a bit hesitant to ask.
Lan Xiang ignored them and kept talking to the “child”.
She was very thin and frail, her voice soft, and she seemed to be in poor health.
“Lan Xiang, it seems like you are not in good health. Did you suffer a serious injury previously?” Bao Zheng asked.
Lan Xiang hugged her child tightly and asked nervously, “Injured … who got injured?”
“You. Did you suffer a serious injury twenty-one years ago?”
“Twenty-one years ago …” Lan Xiang’s eyes were vacant. She looked at Bao Zheng, as if trying to recall.
